ownerOnlyOperations.organization.archive: It ends everyone's access at once and is the first half of deletion.
ownerOnlyOperations.organization.delete: It ends the account. There is no per-module equivalent to delegate.
ownerOnlyOperations.organization.legal-hold: It overrides retention and deletion for everyone, including administrators subject to the hold.
ownerOnlyOperations.organization.ownership.direct-module-tra: Same authority as force-set: it rewrites ownership with no acceptance from either party.
ownerOnlyOperations.organization.ownership.force-set-module-: It bypasses the acceptance step, so it is the ownership lifecycle rather than access administration.
ownerOnlyOperations.organization.ownership.transfer: It changes who holds the account. An admin who could hand it over could take it.
ownerOnlyOperations.organization.purge.cancel: Whoever may schedule destruction must be the only one who may call it off, or the two decisions can be split between people.
ownerOnlyOperations.organization.purge.schedule: It sets a date after which the data cannot be recovered, including the owner's own.
